| description = Gornit spawns at approx 606, -5590 every 6 minutes.  His spawn point puts him mostly submerged in water requiring a caster to be under the water for line of sight.  Resistant to poison.
Has the potential to drop 1-3 giant toes, ice, fire, and hill and up to 30pp.

Rumors says that Gornit, once a proud and young hill giant, was defeated by one of his fellows in a duel for the hand of a beautiful hill giantess that was promised to him. Shamed by such event, Gornit decided that his peers deserved no trust, and thus he decided to leave his home land in the Rathe region. He travelled wide and far, and in one of those voyages he met Dixl Drool and her gang. Amazed by Gornit`s strength and charisma, he was invited to join the crew. Having found a place where he was welcomed, Gornit happily joined the ill-equipped Pirates of Gunthak and is now somewhat frequently seen raiding nearby adventurers, and in very rare ocassions even the travelling boat that passes nearby, in order to finance their impoverished lifestyle.

It is worth noting that despite being welcomed among the Pirates of Gunthak, Gornit is aware that he is considerably stronger than any of them, with the exception of Wiltin Windwalker some would say. The fact that Gornit is part of a bunch of ragtag pirates is not something that redeems his honor, especially considering that he used to dwell among hill giants, one of the fiercest races in Norrath, and that is the reason why he`s heard shouting “Dead Man tell no tales” to any curious that dares to inspect him closer.
